_description: Canonical state machine + billing/idempotency contract for ai_jobs. The worker (worker/executor.ts) and any API that creates or mutates a job MUST obey this. The database also enforces allowed_transitions via the trg_ai_jobs_guard trigger (migrations/0005). This JSON is the single source of truth; keep the trigger and executor in sync with it.

retry_policy._backoff_note: Index by attempt number (attempt 0 failure -> wait 10s, attempt 1 -> 60s, attempt 2 -> 300s). Clamp to the last element if attempt exceeds the array.

reconcile._adjustment_note: If adjustment < 0 write a refund usage_event for the difference; if > 0 write an additional charge. Both use a distinct idempotency_key suffix so a retried finalize cannot double-apply.

price_table._note: Illustrative credit prices. Authoritative table belongs in packages/contracts and is loaded by the worker; keep conservative so reservations never under-charge.

locking_policy.pickup_query: state in (queued, failed) and (next_retry_at is null or next_retry_at <= now())
locking_policy._stale_lock_note: A job whose locked_at is older than lock_timeout_seconds is considered abandoned (worker crash). Recovery re-eligibilizes it for pickup. The executor performs an atomic conditional UPDATE so two workers cannot both win the same row.

audit_policy.storage: audit_logs (append-only); the DB trigger writes a row per state transition automatically

invariants: Clients may REQUEST a job but never create or mutate ai_jobs directly (no authenticated insert/update RLS policy).
estimated_cost_credits is computed server-side before reserved; reservation must succeed (sufficient credits) before entering 'running'.
A job in a terminal state is immutable except for bookkeeping; the DB guard refuses illegal transitions.
Exactly one finalize usage_event per job finalize step (idempotent).
Never store raw model output that may contain secrets; store hashes + redacted text.
